descriptionHtml:
Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5 32GB (2 x 16GB) 6000MHz CL38 Black Desktop Memory Kit (Dynamic Ten-Zone RGB Light Bar / Dual Profile AMD EXPO & Intel XMP 3.0 Compatible / Dual Channel Kit / 1-Year Local Warranty)

Maximize your gaming performance and aesthetic appeal with the Corsair Vengeance RGB DDR5 32GB (2x16GB) 6000MHz Dual Memory Kit in sleek black finish, available at Turbo Computer Egypt backed by a full 1-Year official local agent warranty layout. Engineered for dual-channel architecture, this memory kit delivers optimal memory bandwidth and ultra-fast high frequencies up to 6000MHz with tight CL38 latency timings. Featuring a dynamic panoramic ten-zone RGB light bar enclosed in a solid aluminum heatspreader, it provides fully customizable RGB lighting synchronized across your system using Corsair iCUE software. With native dual profile hardware integration for both AMD EXPO and Intel XMP 3.0, it allows simple one-click BIOS overclocking optimization across modern motherboard platforms.
